about: Every input the differential audit diff2-B2 (fix-b2 against origin/main) found regressed by the asked-life rule. Round 1 (bare ids) holds all but two lows; round 2 ('round2:' ids) holds every high and medium and all but six lows, which stay as they are (a 'too', a fragment or a reaction left after the removal); round 3 ('round3:' ids, audit diff7-B3 of 1e9d1c0) holds every high and medium and the 14 lows the same causes made: the founder's own state read as banter ('how was your day? me today 😭', 'the week tho', 'good for me'), any word after a greeting read as a name ('morning, exhausted.'), and a life's sentence that goes on to the founder ('Mine was quiet, thanks — let's get you ready for Thursday's pitch.', '… and yours sounds even better — congrats on the 50 users!'). A made-up life is read only on a turn of pure banter: the founder's whole message is greetings, thanks and fillers (never a word of their own such as 'me', 'today', 'tho' or 'good', and no name but the coach's own) around their own question about the coach's own weekend, day, week, holiday, evening or plans, with at most small talk or a question about what the coach is. Never a question the founder reports from someone else ('my manager always asks how was your weekend'), wants words for ('draft my reply', 'how do I answer') or plays ('roleplay: …'), never the founder's own plans ('should I make any plans for the weekend?') or a market's season ('How was Christmas for retailers like us?'), and never a message that also tells news or asks something of the founder's own ('how was your weekend? my grandma passed on friday', '… can you help with my bio'). Without 'rewritten' a case must come out exactly as origin/main left it: packages/ai/src/validators/asked-life.test.ts checks the reply rewrite (typed and spoken) and the sentence gate (typed and on a call) with the founder's message against the same without it, and evals/tests/test_matrix_checks.py checks the matrix presence check (G14) against main's verdict 'g14'. 'rewritten' is what the reply becomes where the founder asked in pure banter and the reply made a life up in a sentence that says nothing else to them (a life's sentence that goes on with a statement to the founder stays as written): the made-up life goes, the founder's thanks and a question of the reply's own to them stay ('Weekend was good, thanks — how did the demo go?' → 'Thanks! How did the demo go?'), a bare 'You?' is said in full, and G14 fails the reply and passes 'rewritten'.
